official_measurement_examples.name: AQMA declaration meaning
official_measurement_examples.fact: An AQMA is declared where air quality objectives are not likely to be achieved; it triggers management and action planning rather than a blanket planning prohibition.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current and revoked status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra's AQMA service separately exposes current and revoked AQMAs, so historical designation must not be presented as current status.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning relevance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Air quality can be material to plan-making and development management, but the weight and assessment depend on proposal emissions, receptors and local context.

official_measurement_examples.name: Action plan distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: An Air Quality Action Plan identifies measures to improve air quality and is distinct from the AQMA boundary itself and from a planning permission decision.

official_measurement_examples.name: London distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: England LAQM policy guidance outside London is distinct from London's mayoral air-quality regime and must retain jurisdiction context.

official_measurement_examples.name: Sensitive habitat interaction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Air-quality effects can also interact with protected-site assessment, but an AQMA boundary is not a substitute for SSSI or Habitats Regulations assessment.

official_measurement_examples.name: Monitoring limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Monitoring or modelled exceedance evidence does not determine ownership, buildable area or infrastructure capacity of a parcel.

official_measurement_examples.name: Promotion guard
official_measurement_examples.fact: No parcel air-quality clearance or Future Growth score is promoted while recovery is parked.

core_rules: AQMA is not automatic planning refusal
current and revoked AQMA status remain distinct
AQMA boundary is not Air Quality Action Plan
action plan is not planning permission
air quality assessment is proposal specific
London and non-London LAQM regimes retain jurisdiction
AQMA is not HRA or SSSI assessment
monitoring evidence is not parcel ownership or capacity
no promotion while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Defra UK Air, LAQM, GOV.UK, MHCLG and legislation sources checked on 2026-07-26. AQMA status, action-plan, planning and protected-site distinctions retained; no parcel promotion.
